mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (2.16%) is below 3.0% and historically associated with positive equity market returns, leading to a prediction of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4.0% (indicating a tight labor market) and the federal funds rate is below 3.0% (indicating accommodative monetary policy), the S&P 500 is likely to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with accommodative policy
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4.0% AND FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising), the S&P 500 is likely to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% AND FEDFUNDS rising (3-month change > 0.5%) and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current unemployment rate (5.4%) is above the historical average and has been associated with negative equity market returns, leading to a prediction of negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1800 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand and robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1800 and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1800 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) is above 115, it signals strong demand and supply-side resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1800 AND INDPRO > 115 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO < 110), the S&P 500 is likely to produce negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 110 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of observations, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
